label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00, with an order for 200 fresh loaves to be placed on its four tables and supply, delivery, and payment coordinated among builder, baker, innkeeper, and freight. Builder explicitly requested that it not be discussed with the mayor. The installed lanterns and scheduled lighting review may be connected. Its purpose, including whether it celebrates forty years of mayoral service, remains unknown; no other knowing helpers are established.
